newsitem.title: USA: US stocks pull off lows late despite bond selloff.
newsitem.headline: US stocks pull off lows late despite bond selloff.

text.p: U.S. stocks pulled off session lows in heavy late trading, showing renewed resilience in the face of still selling in the Treasuries market.
The Dow rose seven to 5895, well off a session low 5849.62. The Nasdaq Composite surged 10 to 1203 as technology stocks were still buoyed by Intel's upbeat third-quarter forecast.
"The market was due for a pullback. I said it would be shallow and short-lived and something you want to buy into," said Ralph Bloch, chief technical analyst at Raymond James.
The long bond lost 24/32 to yield 7.01 percent.
